name: infiniscroll
description: Instagram-style infinite scroll feed of AI-generated text posts

scripts.start:bg: nohup node server.js > server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > .server.pid && sleep 1 && echo "InfiniScroll running in background (PID $(cat .server.pid)). Logs: tail -f server.log | Stop: npm run stop"
scripts.stop: ([ -f .server.pid ] && kill $(cat .server.pid) 2>/dev/null && rm -f .server.pid && echo 'Stopped InfiniScroll.') || echo 'Not running (no .server.pid found).'
scripts.reset-feed: rm -f data/posts.json && echo 'Cleared data/posts.json -- next feed request will regenerate from scratch.'
scripts.update: npm run stop && git pull && npm run start:bg
scripts.update:reset: npm run stop && npm run reset-feed && git pull && npm run start:bg
